# LARGE held-out real-data slice: 70 auto-generated real Nature tasks

Across 2 Nature articles, real scientific tables, same operator-semantic
tasks + (ambiguous, clarified) prompts + goldless oracle. Rates with 95% Wilson CIs.

## (1) Silent-error rate on REAL data (large slice)
- ambiguous: 125/140 (89% [95% CI 83-93])
- clarified: 22/140 (16% [95% CI 11-23])

## (2) Oracle recall on real silent errors
- 145/147 (99% [95% CI 95-100])

## (3) Oracle false-positive on real correct results
- 0/131 (0% [95% CI 0-3])

## Reading
- 70 real tasks (vs the 9-table curated slice) makes the external-validity
  claim hard to dismiss as small-sample; CIs are now tight.
